question: Should OpenClaw retire `coalesceSameSenderDms` now and make `imsg` 0.11.1 a hard iMessage startup floor, accepting required doctor and binary-upgrade actions for existing users?
rationale: This intentionally turns previously accepted persisted config and older binaries into fail-closed upgrade states; source and tests can validate mechanics but cannot choose the compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve after transition proof
options.body: Accept the hard floor and config retirement after exact-head macOS proof shows stale-key repair, clear old-version recovery guidance, and one-turn URL split-send delivery.

options.title: Defer retirement
options.body: Keep the current config and client-side fallback until maintainers are ready to require the config migration and binary upgrade together.

recommendation.title: Approve after transition proof
recommendation.body: Accept the hard floor and config retirement after exact-head macOS proof shows stale-key repair, clear old-version recovery guidance, and one-turn URL split-send delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice primarily concerns the supported `imsg` release floor and operator upgrade policy.
